basic_info.description: Discover this beautifully updated single-family home just steps from the Balboa Park Bart Station. The upstairs features two generously sized bedrooms and a modern bathroom, complemented by a bright living room filled with natural light and a formal dining area that opens to a central patio. The brand-new kitchen boasts elegant granite countertops and stainless steel appliances and breakfast nook, while the updated bathroom includes both a tub and a separate shower. The lower level offers versatile living spaces, perfect for guests or family. Enjoy the convenience of a one-car garage and two driveway parking spaces. With easy access to Bart and bus stops, as well as being just minutes from the 280 freeway, this location is ideal. Explore nearby shops and restaurants for a vibrant urban lifestyle.
